headline: Executive order setting rules for physical searches carried out to gather foreign intelligence.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with physical searches, such as searches of property or buildings, done to collect foreign intelligence. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, officials, and limits it sets cannot be described from the source material. It appears to be part of how the executive branch carries out foreign intelligence search authority under federal law.

who_it_affects.group: Federal intelligence and law enforcement agencies
who_it_affects.how: The order likely sets out how these agencies may seek approval for and conduct foreign intelligence physical searches.

who_it_affects.group: People or groups targeted in foreign intelligence investigations
who_it_affects.how: Their property could be subject to physical searches under the process the order covers.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 9, 1995; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
